10530.description:
Around the point the sea changes its temper: the water runs dark and
deep, and a long, heavy swell lifts the boat and lets it down with slow
patience. This side of Cape Voogk is a wall of black basalt split into
tall columns, bearded with icicles where meltwater froze in mid-fall.
West, the way runs back around the point, while the South-Eastern Mira
Retrum stretches away east and south, grey and enormous.

10531.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10531.description:
Under the cliffs lies a narrow beach of grey shingle, worn smooth and
stained dark where seals haul out, and the wind brings their rank, fishy
smell across the water. Ice has built up along the tideline in a ragged
white rind. The boat wallows in the deep swell, and spray freezes in
beads along the gunwale. Open water leads east along the coast, west
toward the cape, and south into the wider gulf.

10532.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10532.description:
A glacier comes down to the sea here between two shoulders of dark rock,
ending in a cliff of ice as blue as deep water where it has freshly
broken. Every so often something gives within it with a crack like a
whip, and a slab slides into the sea with a roar. The water is thick
with brash, the broken leavings of the glacier, which hiss and clink
against the hull. Safer water lies south, away from the falling ice, and
the coast runs on both east and west.

10533.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10533.description:
The face of the glacier walls in the coast here, sheer and fissured, its
blue depths clouded with grit and the dark shapes of stones carried down
from the heights. Chunks calved from it bob in the swell, some as big as
a cottage, rolling over now and then to show their sea-polished bellies.
The air is sharply colder in the shadow of the ice. West, the glacier
front goes on; east and south the water is clearer.

10534.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10534.description:
A frozen waterfall hangs from the lip of the cliffs here, a great pale
beard of ice where a stream once leapt into the sea, and somewhere
behind it water still trickles. Below it the cliff foot hides under a
heaped apron of fallen icicles. The swell runs long and smooth, and the
boat climbs each grey hill of water and slides down its back. Dark
cliffs march away east and west, and to the south the gulf lies open.

10535.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10535.description:
The cliffs above are terraced with narrow ledges, every one whitened
with droppings, and the stink of the rookery drifts out over the water
on the cold air. A din of shrieking and squabbling rises and falls high
overhead, never quite stopping. Feathers float on the black water and
cling to the oars. The ledges run on along the cliffs to the east, the
coast falls back toward the glacier in the west, and the deep gulf opens
south.

10536.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10536.description:
A lone sea stack stands off the cliffs here, a tower of dark rock cut
away from the land by the patient sea, wearing a cap of old snow like a
cowl. The swell bursts against its foot in sheets of white that freeze
where they fall. Between the stack and the cliff runs a slot of black
water too narrow and too wild to risk. Safer water lies east and west
along the coast, and south toward the open gulf.

10537.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10537.description:
The ribs of a wrecked ship stand up from the rocks at the cliff foot
here, black and bare as the bones of some drowned beast, and a stump of
mast still leans from the wreckage. Whatever she carried the sea took
long ago, and ice now fills her hold to the brim. The swell sucks and
gurgles among the rocks around her. You can row on along the coast
either way, east or west, or stand out south into the gulf.

extra_descs.wreck ship ribs mast hull:
Her timbers are blackened oak, bolted with iron that has bled long rusty
tears down the wood. On a split board near the bow you can still make
out a few painted letters: SEA WREN, OF PORT HALYON.

10538.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10538.description:
The cliffs dwindle here into a jumble of fallen boulders furred with
ice, and beyond them, far off over the land, a dark line of forest
stands against the grey. When the wind comes off the shore it carries a
smell of resin and wet needles, strange after so long among salt and
ice. The water runs east toward that wooded shore and west beneath the
cliffs, and the open gulf lies south.

10539.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10539.description:
The gulf comes to a corner here, where the cliffs meet the shore of the
forest, and a reef of black rocks, awash and boiling white, keeps any
boat from the land. Beyond the reef a dark cave mouth opens at the foot
of the cliffs, giving out a low moan each time the swell runs into it.
The water lies open only to the south and back west along the coast.

10540.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10540.description:
The black rock of Cape Voogk gives way here to the Ice Wall, which grows
from the cape's foot like a frozen buttress and runs away into the haze.
Where rock and ice meet, a long crack weeps meltwater into the sea.
West, the water rounds the foot of the cape; north it follows the
cliffs, and to the east and south the gulf spreads wide.

10541.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10541.description:
Pancake ice covers the water here, hundreds of round plates the size of
shields, each with a raised rim where it has bumped against its
neighbours, so that the sea looks paved with pale lily pads. They knock
and whisper together on the swell. North, under the cliffs, the stained
shingle of a seal beach shows dark. Open water runs east, south and
west.

10542.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10542.description:
Chunks calved from the glacier drift out here on the current, blue and
white, some as heavy as wagons, turning slowly as they go. North, the
glacier itself fills a notch in the coast, a frozen river ending in a
cliff. The water is grey and stiff with slush that drags at the oars.
Clearer water lies east, south and west.

10543.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10543.description:
A dirty iceberg drifts here, banded with grey grit and stones the
glacier gathered on its long way down, and a boulder as big as a hut
sits on its crown as if set there on purpose. Every so often a pebble
melts loose and drops into the sea with a small, neat plop. North, the
glacier's face shows blue across the water, and open sea runs east,
south and west.

extra_descs.boulder stone crown:
The boulder is a rounded lump of red granite, nothing like the black
rock of the coast, scored across with long scratches where the glacier
dragged it. Someone has daubed a crude eye on its side in tar, perhaps
for luck, perhaps as a warning.

10544.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10544.description:
Frost smoke rises from the sea in thick, curling wisps, the water so
much warmer than the bitter air that it steams like a cauldron. The
vapour climbs, freezes and glitters, and hides everything beyond an
oar's length. Somewhere north the frozen waterfall must still hang from
its cliff, but nothing shows of it now. The open gulf runs east, south
and west into the white.

10545.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10545.description:
Waves have worn a cave into the flank of an iceberg here, a smooth
hollow whose light glows a deep, unearthly blue, as though the ice held
a lamp somewhere inside. Water drips from its roof in a quick, ringing
patter that echoes out over the swell. From the north drifts the reek of
the bird cliffs, and the gulf runs on east, south and west.

10546.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10546.description:
An iceberg of spires and pinnacles rises here like the ruin of some
white temple, its towers leaning at odd angles and its broken arches
dripping into the sea. Wind moans through its hollows in a long, low
note that rises and falls. Beyond it to the north the sea stack stands
against the cliffs. The water runs on clear to the east, south and west.

10547.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10547.description:
The sea here wells up from far below in slow, oily swirls that smooth
the surface, colder even than the water around and smelling faintly of
fish and deep places. Strands of torn weed turn lazily in the eddies.
North, toward the coast, the black ribs of a wreck show against the
cliffs. The gulf spreads out east, south and west.

10548.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10548.description:
A squall of sleet hisses across the water, stinging the face and
rattling on the boat, and when it passes the world comes back washed and
colder. In the clear spell the coast shows plainly, cliffs falling away
to the north and the dark forest rising beyond the surf to the east. The
swell runs heavy and steep here. South and west, open water reaches back
into the gulf.

10549.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10549.description:
The shore of the Great Forest of MiNar lies close here, a pale strand
beneath overhanging cliffs with dark firs crowding the heights above,
but a line of breakers keeps you off. Whole trees stripped grey by the
sea lie tangled in the shallows beyond the surf. North, the water runs
toward the reef at the gulf's corner, and south it follows the shore,
while to the west the deep gulf spreads out under a low sky.

10550.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10550.description:
Here the boat runs beside a cliff of ice like the side of a mountain:
the Ice Wall, its face banded in layers of white and blue like a cut
cake, each band a year of snow pressed hard. Thin falls of meltwater
spill from ledges far up and turn to spray before they reach the sea.
North, the wall runs on toward the cape; south it marches beside the
water, and east the gulf lies open.

10551.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10551.description:
An iceberg curves here in the shape of a horseshoe, its two arms
enclosing a pool so calm that it mirrors the ice without a ripple.
Outside the arms the swell runs on, but within there is no sound except
the drip of meltwater. A boat could rest there in perfect shelter. The
sea lies open beyond it, north and south, east and west.

10552.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10552.description:
A skin of new ice covers the sea here, thin and dark and so supple that
it bends with the swell instead of breaking, rising and falling like
oiled cloth. Where the bow pushes into it, it splits into long fingers
that slide one over another with a faint, glassy tinkle. The cold is
fierce and still. Beyond the dark sheet, open water shows north, east,
south and west.

10553.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10553.description:
The gulf is at its widest here, a great grey bowl of water ringed with
distant land: cliffs and a glacier on one hand, a dark smudge of forest
on another, and the long, pale line of the Ice Wall on a third. Floes
drift across it slowly, as if they had all the time in the world. The
cold is steady and patient. Open water stretches away in every
direction.

10554.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10554.description:
Growlers drift all about here, lumps of old ice no bigger than a cart,
low in the water and glassy-dark, the kind a careless boat finds only by
striking one. Now and then they knock against the hull with a hollow
sound like knuckles on a door. The air is raw and smells of nothing but
cold. Clear water leads off between them north, east, south and west.

10555.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10555.description:
A pale sun shows through thin cloud, ringed by a great halo of light,
with a false sun glowing at either side like two lanterns hung in the
sky. The ice on every floe glitters beneath it, and the black water is
laid with a bright, trembling road that gives no warmth at all. Clear
water lies open on every hand.

10556.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10556.description:
Something has killed here: a floe drifting past is stained pink and
rust-red along its edge, strewn with torn scraps of blubber and a
scatter of grey feathers. The water around it is very still and very
dark. Faint cries carry from the bird cliffs to the north. Open water
leads east toward a great flat-topped berg, and south and west into the
grey.

10557.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10557.description:
A great flat-topped iceberg towers over the boat here, its sheer white
sides higher than any city wall and so long that both ends are lost in
mist. The waves have cut a deep notch along its waterline, and the swell
surges into the notch and booms. Cold pours off the ice like the draught
from an open door. The water stays open all around its foot, and you can
row on whichever way you choose.

10558.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10558.description:
A raft of drift timber floats here, whole trees washed out from the
forest shore and stripped grey, bound into one tangle by ice frozen
between the trunks. Weed trails beneath it, and the water around is
littered with bark and needles. Beyond the surf to the east the dark
forest stands under a heavy sky, and the gulf opens north, south and
west.

10559.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10559.description:
The swell rears up green over a shoal here and breaks white across
hidden rocks between you and the land, flinging spray that rattles on
the boat like thrown gravel. Beyond the surf, under a long lip of
overhanging cliff, a shadowed strand follows the coast, and above it the
forest stands dark and silent. North and south the water runs beside the
breakers, and west it falls away into the deep.

10560.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10560.description:
The Ice Wall rises right beside the boat, and high in its face a cave
opens like a round blue throat, running back into the ice farther than
you can see. Meltwater drips from its lip in a steady chain of drops,
each one ringing as it lands. Breath smokes in the cold that flows down
out of it. North and south the water runs along the wall, and east lies
the open gulf.

10561.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10561.description:
A current sets hard across the gulf here, and where it meets the swell
the water stands up in short, steep ridges that never move on, breaking
and re-forming in the same place over and over. The boat bucks and
slews, and you must lean on the oars to hold a course. Beyond the rip,
the pale cliff of the Ice Wall shows through the haze. Rough water runs
on north, east, south and west.

10562.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10562.description:
A ship's boat lies locked in a floe here, frozen in up to her thwarts,
her planks silvered with frost and her bow lifted as though she were
still trying to climb free. No one has sat in her for many winters, and
gulls have whitened her gunwale. Open water winds around the floe,
leading north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.boat ship's thwarts planks transom rope:
A name has been burned into her transom: WREN'S CHICK. A rusted iron
ring is still set in her bow, and from it hangs a stump of frayed rope,
cut clean through.

10563.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10563.description:
Jade-green ice rises from the sea here in a low, heavy berg, the colour
of seawater frozen from beneath rather than snow pressed from above, its
flanks as smooth and glossy as polished stone. It sits so deep that the
swell washes over its shoulders without stirring it. The boat feels very
small beside it. The way is open on every side.

10564.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10564.description:
The clouds are low and grey, but their undersides glow a hard, bright
white wherever ice lies out of sight beneath them, so that the sky
itself is a map of the frozen sea. Under that pale light the water looks
black as ink. A few rotten floes drift past, grey and sodden, sinking
slowly into slush. Open water reaches away on every side.

10565.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10565.description:
Snow falls thick and slow here, great soft flakes that drift down
without a sound and vanish the moment they touch the black water. It
gathers on the gunwale and on your shoulders, and it closes the world in
until only a few boat-lengths of sea remain. Somewhere out in the
whiteness, ice is grinding. Open water seems to run on in every
direction, as far as the snow lets you see.

10566.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10566.description:
Two great floes have shoved together and buckled, throwing up a ridge of
tilted blocks like a broken wall, each slab as thick as a man is tall
and glazed green beneath. The ridge creaks and shifts as the swell works
at it, and now and then a block topples into the sea with a heavy slap.
Open water skirts the ridge on every side, leaving your way free in any
direction.

10567.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10567.description:
The long white flank of a flat-topped iceberg runs off into the mist to
the north, and from here you can see where a slab has fallen from its
corner, leaving a raw blue scar. Rubble of shattered ice still spreads
over the water, clinking as it knocks together. The wind has dropped,
and the stillness is so deep you can hear the ice settling. East, south
and west, the gulf lies open.

10568.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10568.description:
An iceberg has rolled over here, and its upturned belly rises from the
sea smooth and glassy, the green-blue of old bottle glass and shot
through with trapped bubbles. Water streams from its flanks in little
falls, and it rocks very slowly, still finding its balance. Faintly,
from the east, comes the sound of surf on the shore; north, south and
west the gulf is open.

10569.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern End of Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10569.description:
A gap opens in the reef here, a lane of dark, quieter water where the
surf cannot find its footing, and it leads east toward the very end of
Mira Retrum and a landing beneath the cliffs. The smell of the forest is
strong, resin and leaf mould riding on the cold. North and south the
breakers run on along the shore, and west lies the open gulf.

10570.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10570.description:
This is a cold corner of the gulf, where the sheer cliff of the Ice Wall
comes down to meet the drift ice, and the two grind against each other
with a sound like a mill that never stops. Ice dust hangs in the air and
glitters. Only two ways lead out of the corner: north beside the wall,
or east along the edge of the floes.

10571.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10571.description:
A lead of black water opens into the drift ice here, a long, narrow lane
between the floes that widens and narrows as the ice breathes, tempting
and treacherous. Slush clots along its edges. Nobody wise would row into
it, for it can close in a heartbeat. The open gulf lies north, and the
ice-edge runs on to the east and west.

10572.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10572.description:
An iceberg has been caught fast in the edge of the drift ice and leans
at a drunken slant, its high side white and its low side green where the
sea has been at it. The floes around it are heaved and cracked from the
pressure, and now and then it groans like a ship's timbers in a storm.
The open gulf is north, and the ice-edge leads on east and west.

10573.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10573.description:
Floes have been driven one over another along the edge of the drift ice
here, stacked like roofing slates in a builder's yard, and the topmost
plates hang out over the water with icicles dripping from their lips.
The heap creaks and settles as the swell moves beneath it. Open water
lies north in the gulf and runs along the ice-edge east and west.

10574.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10574.description:
The swell runs in under the drift ice here, and the whole white field
rises and falls in long, slow ripples, like a sheet shaken out by giant
hands. Floes clap together as each wave passes, and slush squeezes up
between them with a wet sigh. The open gulf lies north, and the edge of
the ice leads on to the east and west.

10575.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10575.description:
Mist lies over the drift ice here, so that the floe-edge seems to
dissolve into nothing a few yards off, and from somewhere inside the
whiteness comes the sharp crack and long groan of ice breaking. Droplets
bead on every rope and freeze there. The darker water of the gulf to the
north is easier to trust, and the ice-edge runs on east and west.

10576.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10576.description:
A broad floe lies against the edge of the drift ice here, flat and
white, and in its middle a pool of meltwater shines as blue as a stone
set in a silver brooch. Its rim has rotted into a low lip of honeycombed
ice that crumbles wherever the swell washes over it. North, the gulf
opens deep and grey, while east and west the ragged ice-edge runs on.

10577.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10577.description:
The wind comes howling down off the drift ice, lifting spindrift from
the floes in long white streamers that hiss across the water and sting
like thrown sand. Beyond the edge the ice runs on, ridged and broken,
until it fades into a blur of blowing snow. The boat pitches in a short,
cold chop. Shelter of a sort lies north toward the great flat-topped
berg, and the floe-edge runs on east and west.

10578.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10578.description:
The drift ice lies hard by, a broken plain of floes, slabs and pressure
ridges that lifts and settles with the swell like the breathing of some
vast sleeping thing. Its edge is a ragged line of slush and tilted
plates that grind together with a sound like millstones. Frost smoke
rises from the narrow strip of open water beside it. The way lies north
into the gulf, or east and west along the ice.

10579.name: The South-Eastern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10579.description:
Here the gulf ends in a corner between the breakers off the shore and
the edge of the drift ice, a heaving white field of broken floes jammed
together as far as the eye can follow. Where the two meet they grind and
groan in a confusion that no boat could live through. The only clear
water runs north along the shore and west beside the edge of the ice.

10580.name: The South-Eastern End of Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On the Ocean Shore.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10580.description:
The sea ends here against a steep bank of grey shingle, where the swell
runs up hissing and draws back with the rattle of a thousand stones.
East, the shingle rises into the mouth of a long, low gallery that the
waves have carved beneath overhanging cliffs, a dry place to drag a boat
ashore. High above, the firs of the Great Forest of MiNar lean out over
the edge. West, the water widens back into the gulf.

10581.name: On the Ocean Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along the Ocean Shore.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

west.description: To the west lies The South-Eastern End of Mira Retrum.

10581.description:
You stand on dry shingle in a long gallery the sea has gnawed from the
cliff foot, its roof of dark rock low enough to touch and hung with pale
roots from the forest above. Grey light and the sound of surf come in
from the open side, where the beach slopes west to the water's edge.
North, the gallery runs on along the shore in shadow. East, a cleft in
the back wall slopes out to the edge of the Great Forest of MiNar, and
the smell of pine comes through it.

10588.name: Along the Ocean Shore

north.description: To the north lies Along the Ocean Shore.

south.description: To the south lies On the Ocean Shore.

10588.description:
The gallery runs on beneath the cliff, its floor a strip of cold shingle
between the rock wall and the lapping edge of the sea. Driftwood lies
heaped against the wall, bleached and smoothed, and roots dangle through
cracks in the roof, dripping steadily onto the stones. The air is damp
and smells of salt and wet earth. South, the gallery widens toward the
landing; north it bends on along the shore, growing dimmer.

10589.name: Along the Ocean Shore

north.description: To the north lies At an Ocean Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Along the Ocean Shore.

10589.description:
The roof comes down low here and you must stoop, the rock above slick
with seepage and crusted with salt where spray has dried. A tidal pool
lies in a hollow of the floor, so clear and still that the weed and pink
shells in it look painted. From somewhere ahead comes a deep, slow
booming, the sea breathing in and out of a cave. North, the gallery
leads on toward that sound, and south it opens back along the shore.

10590.name: At an Ocean Cave

south.description: To the south lies Along the Ocean Shore.

down.description: To the down lies A Cave-Mouth Leading Into the Sand.

10590.description:
The gallery ends in a high, echoing cave whose walls glisten with brine,
and every swell that runs in through a crack in the rock fills the place
with a sound like a great drum. In the middle of the floor a shaft drops
down into wet, packed sand, but a fall of rock and old timber has choked
it, sealing whatever lies below. The only open way is back south along
the shore.

extra_descs.shaft sand timber rock fall:
Someone once shored this shaft with ship's timbers, and the timbers gave
way under the weight of sand and stone. Through a gap between the fallen
slabs you can glimpse the edge of a carved stone step, green with weed,
before the dark swallows it.

10704.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10704.description:
Two stranded icebergs stand like gateposts here, their bases gnawed by
the waves into dripping overhangs, and your boat rides the swell in the
gap between them. North, the gap opens onto the wider grey of the
Southern Ocean, while south the water runs on among scattered floes. A
bank of fog sits on the water to the west, so thick and still that a
boat rowed into it soon drifts back out where it began. Close beyond the
bergs looms the black headland of Cape Voogk, crusted with old snow.

10705.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10705.description:
In this corner the stranded bergs and the pack ice have frozen into one
another, making a single white wall that curves around the boat, and the
water lies still and black in its shelter. Icicles hang from the
overhangs, and the ice ticks and creaks as it settles. You can leave
only east, along the line of bergs, or south beside the pack.

10706.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10706.description:
A tunnel runs through the stranded berg before you, a blue-lit bore
through the ice with a pale circle of daylight at its far end, but its
throat is packed with brash and slush that heave with every swell, and
no boat could pass. A cold wind breathes out of it. The line of bergs
runs east and west, and south lies the open sea.

10707.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10707.description:
A stranded berg here has been carved by wind and wave into the likeness
of a castle, with a squat keep, a crumbling curtain wall and a gate-arch
filled solid with ice, and the swell boils white about its foot like a
moat. Snow lies along its battlements. East and west the grounded bergs
stand in their line, and south the open sea waits.

10708.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10708.description:
The shoal that grounds the stranded bergs comes close to the surface
here, and the boat's keel scrapes ominously over rocks furred with weed.
Brown kelp streams in the current, and the swell steepens and breaks in
odd places with no warning. The bergs tower beside you in their line,
running east and west, and deeper water lies south.

10709.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10709.description:
A stranded berg is melting here, streaming from a hundred places at
once, so that its face is hung with little waterfalls that splash and
chuckle down into the sea. The water around it is fresh enough to taste
and full of tumbling chips of ice. The grounded bergs run east and west
from it, and south the sea lies open.

10710.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10710.description:
Two stranded bergs lean together here, and the gap between them is
choked with a jumble of broken ice, slabs and blocks frozen into one
heaving mass that groans as the swell works at it. No boat could force a
way through. The line of bergs goes on east and west, and south lies the
open water.

10711.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10711.description:
The sea has bored a hole clean through the foot of a stranded berg here,
and each swell that runs into it bursts out of a vent in the ice above
in a roaring spout of spray, hanging in the air a moment before it rains
down glittering. The ice all around the vent is glazed and fluted. East
and west the grounded bergs run on in their long line, and south the
open sea is quieter.

10712.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10712.description:
One of the stranded bergs has been worn here into a tall, thin spire,
leaning out over the water like an accusing finger, and the sea has
eaten so deeply into its base that it seems certain to fall. Icicles
hang from its underside in a ragged fringe. The line of grounded bergs
runs on east and west, and the open sea lies south.

10713.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10713.description:
The stranded bergs stand in a wall here, grounded so hard on their
hidden shoal that the swell breaks against them as against a cliff, and
only rubble and brash fill the gaps between. Their bases are scooped
into dark, dripping overhangs. East, the line runs on toward the gap
beside the cape's black cliffs; west it stretches away into the haze,
and south the sea opens out.

10714.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10714.description:
The black cliffs of Cape Voogk rise sheer from the water close beside
you, streaked white by nesting birds and glazed with ice wherever the
spray can reach. A line of stranded icebergs runs away to the west,
aground on some hidden shoal, and only the narrow gap to the north lets
out onto the open sea. Swell rebounds off the cliff foot and slaps the
hull from two sides at once. South, the water opens out among drifting
floes.

10715.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10715.description:
The pack ice here is old ice, many years old, its floes worn into
rolling hummocks like snowy hills, smooth and blue-white, with old
meltpools frozen into glassy hollows between them. It lies quieter than
the newer ice, heavy and sure of itself. The water runs north toward the
stranded bergs, south along the pack, and east into the open sea.

10716.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10716.description:
Floes broken from the pack wander out across the water here, slow and
heavy, thick slabs of old ice with snow drifted on their backs and green
weed fringing their undersides. They jostle the boat with gentle,
ponderous shoves. West, the pack itself lies white and close; the
stranded bergs stand north, and open water runs east and south.

10717.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10717.description:
Rafts of kelp torn loose by some storm drift here, great tangled mats of
brown weed and floats knotted together, and they wrap around the oars
and drag at the boat. Small shells and splinters of wood are caught up
in them. East, the living kelp forest sways beneath the surface; north
stand the stranded bergs, and south and west the water is clear.

10718.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10718.description:
A forest of kelp grows up from the bottom here, its long brown fronds
swaying just below the surface and its floats bobbing on top like
strings of olives. The water among the weed is calm and smells of iodine
and salt. North the stranded bergs stand on their shoal; elsewhere the
kelp thins out into open sea.

10719.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10719.description:
A small white sun hangs low over the sea here, round and hard as a
silver coin and about as warm, and every floe throws a long blue shadow
across the water. Your own breath hangs in front of your face. The
stranded bergs glint in a line to the north, and the other ways lie open
among the floes.

10720.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10720.description:
A broad, low floe rides here, worn smooth and stained brown in great
patches where heavy bodies lie to sleep, and tufts of coarse grey hair
are frozen into the ice. The smell of seal is rank and strong, and a
distant grunting and coughing carries across the floes. North stand the
grounded bergs; elsewhere clear water lies all around the floe.

10721.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10721.description:
The air plays tricks here: far-off icebergs seem drawn out into towers
and battlements, and some float clear of the sea altogether, upside
down, like castles hung from the clouds. They shimmer, shrink and grow
again as you watch. Nearer at hand the water is flat and grey, and the
stranded bergs stand to the north. Real open water, at least, lies on
every hand.

10722.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10722.description:
Grease ice lies thick on the water here, a soupy film of frozen crystals
that takes the shine off the sea and smooths every wave, so that the
surface looks dull and oily, like fat cooling in a pan. The oars slide
through it with a soft hiss. North rise the stranded bergs, and east,
south and west the dull water stretches on.

10723.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10723.description:
Somewhere among the floes, seals are barking, a hoarse, echoing chorus
that carries far over the flat grey water and stops as suddenly as it
began. The nearest floe is pocked with round breathing holes, their rims
glazed with frozen spittle and worn smooth by whiskered snouts. North,
the stranded bergs stand in a line against the sky, and the sea runs on
east, south and west.

10724.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies Cape Voogk.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10724.description:
The point of Cape Voogk is near enough here that you can hear the sea
working in its caves, a hollow boom that comes and goes with the swell.
East, the water swings out around the cape itself, where a white race of
current marks the turn. Rimed grey floes nudge one another in the slack
water, and frost smoke curls off the open leads between them. Northward
lies the gap in the stranded bergs, and the open sea runs on to the west
and south.

10725.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10725.description:
Along the edge of the pack ice the floes have been driven together into
a pressure ridge, a wall of upended blocks taller than a man, glazed
green at their broken edges and heaped with snow. Every so often the
ridge shudders and a block crashes down. You can follow it north or
south, or turn east into open water.

10726.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10726.description:
Someone has built a cache on the floe here: a low cairn of stones,
carried out from some far beach, heaped over whatever lies beneath, with
the curved ribs of a seal poking out between them. A bone stake topped
with a tuft of hide marks the spot. Other floes jostle around it, and
the water is open on every side.

10727.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10727.description:
From here the edge of the pack ice can be seen to the west, a long white
line of jammed floes that grinds and mutters without rest, and loose
pieces broken from it come drifting past the boat one by one. The light
is flat and grey, and the sea has no shine to it. North, south and east
the water stays clear.

10728.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10728.description:
The water here is so clear that you can see straight down to the bottom,
a long way below, where pale starfish and spiny urchins lie scattered
over grey stones like dropped jewellery. Your boat seems to hang in the
air above them. The cold rises off the water in a breath you can feel.
All around, the sea stretches open.

10729.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10729.description:
Two pillars of ice stand up from the sea here, all that remains of an
arched iceberg whose span has fallen, and the wreckage of the arch still
drifts between them in a raft of blue blocks. They lean a little farther
apart each season. South, the black skerry shows low over the water, and
the sea is open north, east and west as well.

10730.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10730.description:
The air itself glitters here, filled with tiny crystals of ice that
drift and sparkle in the thin sunlight like dust in a sunbeam, though
there is no cloud for them to fall from. They settle on your eyelashes
and sting the skin. It is very still and very cold. The sea, calm and
pale, lies open on every side.

10731.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10731.description:
A low floe drifts here so fouled with droppings that its snow is
streaked yellow and green, and the reek of it, fishy and sharp, catches
in the throat. Its surface is scored with long, smooth furrows where
small bodies have tobogganed on their bellies to the water's edge, over
and over. Open leads run off from it every way you might want to go.

10732.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10732.description:
Someone camped on a broad floe here not long ago: a windbreak of cut
snow blocks still stands in a half-ring, slumping now, around a black
smudge of soot and a scatter of fish bones. Tracks of boots lead to the
floe's edge and stop. The open sea lies all about it, north and south,
east and west.

10733.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10733.description:
An oar has been frozen upright into a floe here, its blade snapped off
and its shaft wrapped in a scrap of faded red cloth, set as a marker by
someone who meant to come back. Beyond the floe the black point of Cape
Voogk looms close. Small floes drift past on every side, but the water
stays open north, east, south and west.

10734.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies Around Cape Voogk.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10734.description:
East, the sea swings round the foot of Cape Voogk, where the black rock
of the cape vanishes beneath the first pale cliffs of the Ice Wall, and
the current runs out that way in ropy, glassy swirls. On this side the
water lies grey and quiet, scattered with small floes that turn as they
drift. North, the point of the cape shows dark, and south and west the
Southern Mira Retrum stretches away into mist.

10735.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10735.description:
An iceberg has been caught in the pack ice here and frozen fast,
standing up out of the jammed floes like a ship locked in harbour for
the winter, its sides scoured by the grinding ice around it. The pack
heaves against it with a deep, steady groaning. Clear water runs along
the pack's edge north and south, and the open sea lies east.

10736.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10736.description:
The sun has sunk low behind the clouds, and a long, level light pours
out beneath them, turning the pack ice to the west a soft gold and the
nearby floes to rose and amber. Every ripple holds a spark. The cold
sharpens as the light fades. Open water leads north, east and south, and
west toward the glowing ice.

10737.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10737.description:
An iceberg here has been pierced clean through by the sea, leaving a
great arch tall enough for a ship to sail under, its roof hung with
icicles and its inner walls glowing a deep, clear blue. Drips fall from
the span in a steady patter. Rowing beneath it would be a fine thing, if
you trusted it more. Open water runs on around the berg on every side.

10738.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10738.description:
Freezing fog lies on the sea here, and wherever it touches it grows
rime, long white feathers of frost that build up on the oars, the
gunwale and your hood until the boat looks furred like a winter beast.
Sound carries strangely; the swell on the skerry close to the east seems
to come from everywhere at once. The open sea runs on unseen to the
north, south and west.

10739.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10739.description:
A low skerry of black rock rises from the sea here, glazed with ice and
streaked with frozen spray, and on its crown squats a hut of piled
stones roofed with whale jawbones and turf, a hunters' shelter against
the worst of the weather. A smoke-stained hide hangs across its doorway.
The swell creams around the rocks, and the boat rides in their lee. Open
water lies all about the skerry.

extra_descs.hut stones shelter jawbones turf:
Peering in past the hide, you see a hut barely big enough for three to
lie down, its floor spread with old moss and its walls black with soot.
A row of names has been scratched into the lintel stone, and beneath
them, more freshly cut, someone has added: GONE TO THE BAY.

10740.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10740.description:
A long, oily swell is running here, the leavings of some storm far
beyond sight, and the floes lift and settle on it in slow unison, like
sleepers breathing. Each crest rolls under the boat without breaking.
West, a low black skerry rises close at hand, the swell creaming white
around its foot. Open water runs north, east and south.

10741.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10741.description:
A thin grey drizzle falls here and freezes the moment it lands, glazing
the oars, the gunwale and your sleeves in a crust of clear ice that
crackles when you move. The floes are glossy with it. Through the murk
to the west a low black skerry shows above the water, and the open sea
runs on north, east and south.

10742.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10742.description:
Each time the oars dip here the water flares with tiny green sparks, as
if the sea were full of drowned stars, and the boat leaves a faint
glowing wake that fades slowly behind. Under the low grey cloud the glow
is easy to see. The sea is calm, and the boat is free to go any way at
all.

10743.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10743.description:
Every little while a boom like a thunderclap rolls out from the Ice Wall
as some piece of its face gives way, and a moment later a long, heavy
ripple arrives to lift the boat and rock it. Chips of fresh ice come
bobbing out across the water, clear as glass. The wall stands to the
east; north, south and west the sea lies open.

10744.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10744.description:
The Ice Wall rises sheer beside the boat, too high to see the top of, a
cliff of blue-white ice grooved from crest to waterline by old meltwater
and glazed with new. A cold draught spills down its face and across the
water like air from a cellar. North, the wall bends toward the cape;
south it runs on unbroken, and west the open sea lies grey.

10745.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10745.description:
Fog lies over the pack ice here, so thick that the white of the ice and
the white of the air run together, and the edge of the floes is only a
grey line where the water stops. Out in the fog the pack cracks and
shifts with sounds like slammed doors. The water runs north and south
along the edge, and east, away from it.

10746.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10746.description:
The floes here are old and rotten, grey and honeycombed with holes,
sagging into the sea under their own weight, and every so often one
gives way with a soft, wet collapse into slush. The water around them is
cloudy with crumbled ice. The pack groans not far off. Clearer water
lies north, east, south and west.

10747.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10747.description:
A bow of pale light arches over the mist here, white instead of
coloured, a ghostly rainbow with its feet set somewhere out on the
floes. It moves when the boat moves, always the same distance off.
Beneath it the water is grey and gentle, and you may row on in any
direction you please.

10748.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10748.description:
A hole has opened in the clouds overhead, and through it shows a hard,
deep blue sky, so that one shaft of sunlight falls on the sea here and
sets the nearest bergs blazing white. Outside that pool of light the
world stays grey. It feels almost warm for a moment. Open water lies all
around, every way you look.

10749.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10749.description:
A hidden rock lies just under the surface here, and every so often the
swell rears up over it, green and glassy, and breaks in a sudden burst
of white that falls back hissing. Between breakers there is nothing to
show it is there. North, the black skerry rises above the water; east,
south and west, the sea is deep again.

10750.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10750.description:
An iceberg floats here worn into a great round dome, smooth and white
and pitted with hollows, so that from some angles it looks uncomfortably
like a vast skull half sunk in the sea. Water drips from the brows of
its empty eye sockets. The boat's wake slaps against it and echoes
oddly. Beyond it, the sea is open all round.

10751.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10751.description:
The sea lies in a dead calm here, so smooth that every iceberg stands on
its own reflection and the floes seem to hang above a second, upside-
down world. The only movement is the slow ring of ripples spreading from
your oars, and not a breath of wind stirs. Open water lies all around
you, glassy in every direction.

10752.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10752.description:
An iceberg drifts here veined with stripes of clear, deep blue where
meltwater ran into its cracks and froze again, so that it looks like
white marble shot through with sapphire. Its top is crusted with old
snow that the wind has carved into sharp ridges. Open water surrounds
it, running north and south, east and west.

10753.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10753.description:
Meltwater pouring off the Ice Wall lies over the sea here in a cold,
fresh layer, and where the oars dip they leave trails that shimmer and
blur like heat over a summer road. A cupped handful tastes almost sweet.
The wall itself stands close to the east, streaming with a dozen thin
falls. Leads of open water wander off north, south and west between the
floes.

10754.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10754.description:
A great crack splits the Ice Wall from its crest to the sea here, a dark
seam choked far back with fallen ice, and the wind sighs in and out of
it like something breathing. Blocks that dropped from its lips lie half
sunk in the water at its foot, slowly turning blue. The wall runs on
north and south, and the sea opens west.

10755.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10755.description:
A line of poles runs off across the pack here, each topped with a rag or
a tuft of hide, marking the way hunters cross the ice in the deep of
winter, though no one could walk it now, with the floes heaving and
leads opening between them. The pack creaks and grumbles endlessly. Open
water follows its edge north and south, and runs east into the sea.

extra_descs.poles pole rags hide line:
The nearest pole is a whale's rib driven deep into the ice, hung with a
strip of red-dyed hide and a little carved bone fish that clicks against
it in the wind. The poles beyond it march away over the pack, each a
little fainter, until the white swallows them.

10756.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10756.description:
A black band runs through the iceberg here, a stripe of grit and ash
laid down in some year when a mountain burned far away and its smoke
fell on the snow, and the berg is clean white above and below it. The
sea has worn the dark band into a deep groove. Open water lies around it
every way.

10757.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10757.description:
A snow squall closes in here, driving thick and sideways, and in a
moment the world is gone: no bergs, no floes, no sky, only whirling
white and the grey water slapping at the bow. Ice crusts your eyebrows.
When the squall thins, the open sea shows again all round, north and
south, east and west.

10758.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10758.description:
An iceberg rises here in the shape of a great crouching beast, its head
low between its paws and its back humped, as if it were waiting for
something to pass. Wind has polished its flanks to a glassy sheen. The
boat's shadow slides across its feet. The sea runs open past it, north
and south, east and west.

10759.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10759.description:
Far off across the floes something breathes out with a long, booming
whoosh, and a column of mist rises above the ice, hangs, and drifts
apart in the wind. Then there is nothing but the slap of water and the
creak of the floes. The sea around the boat is wide and empty, and the
way lies open north, east, south and west.

10760.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10760.description:
Seen through the haze, the iceberg here looks for a heartbeat like a
tall ship under full sail, its pinnacles standing like masts and its
flank like a white hull heeled over to the wind. Closer, it is only ice,
groaning softly as it turns. Open water runs past it whichever way you
turn.

10761.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10761.description:
Deep inside a clear-sided iceberg here a dark shape is frozen, long and
coiled, too big for any fish and too long for any whale, with what might
be a ridge of fins along its back. The ice around it is flawless, as if
it had been sealed there on purpose. It is hard to look away. The sea is
open north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.shape iceberg ice coiled serpent:
Peering close, you can make out a head as long as a boat, its jaws half
open, and pale scales furred with frost along a body that coils back on
itself again and again. Whether it is dead or only sleeping, there is no
telling.

10762.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10762.description:
A squall of hail sweeps across the sea here, hard white pellets that
bounce off the floes, rattle in the bottom of the boat and pock the
water into a hissing grey froth. It passes almost as quickly as it came,
leaving a thin white crust on every surface. Behind it the water lies
open again to the north, east, south and west.

10763.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10763.description:
A sheet of young ice has formed in the lee of the floes here, and on it
grow frost flowers, thousands of feathery white crystals no taller than
a thumb, delicate as lace and gone at a touch. They glitter like a
meadow of salt in the grey light. East, the Ice Wall looms near, and
north, south and west the water lies open between the floes.

10764.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10764.description:
The foot of the Ice Wall is buried here under an apron of fallen blocks,
some as big as cottages, heaped where they crashed down from the face,
and fresh blue scars high on the cliff show where they came from. It
would be a poor place to linger when the ice is restless. North and
south the water runs beside the wall; west lies open sea.

10765.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10765.description:
The pack ice ends here in a beach of slush and brash, a shifting margin
of broken ice that rises and falls with the swell and sighs as it moves.
Beyond it the pack runs out of sight, white and jagged. Open water runs
north and south along its edge, and east toward the middle of the sea.

10766.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10766.description:
Not far off, the pack ice and the ice shelf grind together where they
meet, and the noise of it fills the air: a ceaseless creaking and
groaning, broken now and then by a crack like an oak splitting. A haze
of powdered ice hangs over the meeting place. Open water still leads
north, east, south and west, but the boat trembles with every crack.

10767.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10767.description:
Without warning a gust comes pouring down off the ice shelf here, bitter
and heavy, flattening the sea into a hissing sheet of spray and shoving
the boat sideways before dying as suddenly as it came. Then the water
lies still again, ruffled and grey. The shelf glimmers a little way off.
The way is open in every direction.

10768.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10768.description:
A thin rind of new ice has formed here, hard and brittle as window
glass, and the bow breaks it into long, ringing shards that skate away
across the surface with a sound like tinkling bells. Behind the boat a
black lane of water marks your passage. The ice shelf shows as a low
white line beyond. Past the rind, the sea is open every way.

10769.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10769.description:
A broad avenue of open water runs here between two enormous floes, dark
and straight as a canal, and the floes' edges stand up on either hand
like low white walls. The water in it is still, and the boat glides with
barely a sound. Side leads branch off between the floes, so you may go
on in any direction.

10770.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

10770.description:
A pool of meltwater has gathered on the top of a squat iceberg here and
spills over its rim in a little waterfall, a silver thread that falls
the height of a tower and patters into the sea. The splash has worn a
smooth hollow in the berg's flank. The ice shelf lies white and low not
far off. Open water stretches away on every hand.

10771.name: The Southern Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Mira Retrum.
